settings.title: Web Search
settings.description: Search engines, bookmarks and shortcuts for the launcher. Engine modifiers and aliases work in the global search.

engine.label: Default Search Engine
engine.description: Used for plain queries and the fallback search row

directUrl.label: Direct URL Opening
directUrl.description: Open URLs directly in the browser instead of searching for them

favicons.label: Website Icons
favicons.description: Fetch site favicons from Google (adds a small WEB badge)

maxResults.label: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Limit the number of results shown for a query

shortcuts.label: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Type an alias to open the page instantly. Example: ma -> Yandex Market, yh -> YouTube history.
shortcuts.name: Name

bookmarks.label: Bookmarks
bookmarks.description: Priority pages. A matching bookmark is promoted above web search results. Type bookmark <url> in the launcher to add one.
bookmarks.title: Title

engines.label: Custom Search Engines
engines.description: Custom engine modifiers. Type the key, a space, then the query. Example: gh noctalia.
engines.name: Name
